title: A hyperbolic geodesic and the robust infinite branch
exact_target: If a Finsler metric on $S^2$ has one hyperbolic prime closed geodesic, must it have infinitely many geometrically distinct prime closed geodesics? Prime means that the geodesic is not an iterate; hyperbolic means that the linearized return map has no eigenvalue on the unit circle.
